issuer_identity.role: Only HQ-delegated future C1 source-free owner

registrar_trust_root.issuer_epoch_identity: HQ-adopted issuer exact identity + one immutable provisioned deployment epoch ref, allocated and approved only after HQ adoption
registrar_trust_root.root_bootstrap: HQ-adopted warrant exact ref plus owner deployment trust-root manifest pinned by authorized bootstrap. Verifier loads pinned allowlisted issuer epoch/root independently of request AND registrar return message; approve root rotation by explicit governed event; never latest/default
registrar_trust_root.registrar_write_capability: Not part of public C1/N10E signatures. Owned by future accepted C1 fixture owner and authorized through bootstrap; journal writes atomic and append-only
registrar_trust_root.verifier_read_capability: Lookup through independently provisioned trusted owner journal/immutable snapshot anchored to adopted warrant and epoch; no caller-provided registry instance/map as root
registrar_trust_root.attestation_choice: OWNER_JOURNAL_MEMBERSHIP_WITH_TRUSTED_BOOTSTRAP, not a claim of a cryptographic signature. Signed credentials permitted only under separately approved key custody; no key generated by this proposal.

site_context_preimage.issuance_prerequisite: Owner receives authenticated callsite capability unavailable to ordinary request caller. Issuer derives exact single token from callsite; client does NOT provide it.

identity_and_uniqueness.future_references: All exact refs are kind+object_id+content_hash under admitted PRE553 canonical JSON SHA256; no authority by hash alone; runtime registry membership and provenance required
identity_and_uniqueness.build_identity: Candidate kind C1_AT07_FIXTURE_BUILD_INSTANCE@1; proposed object_id from unique (issuer epoch, persistent atomic sequence, source build provenance); preimage retains owner event + fixture content hashes; one content-identical but separately built source consumes a DIFFERENT persistent event sequence and DIFFERENT build ref
identity_and_uniqueness.build_sequence: Owner-allocated persisted monotone sequence within unique issuer epoch, atomic reservation/commit, no reset/reuse after restart/revocation, no reliance on process-local nonce alone; collision is refusal not overwriting
identity_and_uniqueness.credential_identity: Candidate kind C1_AT07_FIXTURE_USE_CONTEXT@1; digest over issued use-event material including build_ref, full invocation refs, use-site, original registered issuer epoch/warrant, exact source/release and witness, status_at_issuance; never hash a payload that includes its own digest
identity_and_uniqueness.registry_membership: Verifier must match exact original journal record by full ref and content, issuer epoch and deployment root, and must read current negative lifecycle state independently; no latest/default/fallback
identity_and_uniqueness.collision: Duplicate event_id or (issuer epoch, sequence) with different preimage => integrity conflict. Duplicate context_id with different scope => refuse. Distinct sequence for identical fixture content => distinct identity; cannot equate or exchange
identity_and_uniqueness.metadata_is_not_semantic_time: registration event sequence, issued_at and optional expiry are credential lifecycle data; never substitute snapshot static AT07_FIXTURE_ONLY or conditioner actual null effective context

transitions.proof: owner-verified R8 C11 release+manifest/source rows, atomic issuer event and immutable build-instance ref
actual query/predicate/consumer/conditioner/witness and null effective-context checks; no model creation prerequisite
authenticated owner ingress, one exact permitted token, registered use-event and context ref
trusted verifier retrieves original journal event and checks exact active status and caller supplied materials
explicit sequenced recorded reason/event; affects future/current positive use, audit replay retained
only when expiry actually registered and reached under trusted validity clock, no default expiry invented
exact explicit successor event/new ref, no implicit latest selection
new authorization needs entirely new issuer event/ref after competent review; never revive old ref

verifier_resolution: Obtain expected site from owner-controlled C1/N10E ingress capability, never from request's text
Resolve exact adopted HQ warrant and issuer epoch from independently provisioned trust-root allowlist; stop if absent/unadopted
Resolve ExactRef from authoritative append-only journal; verify event issuer/warrant/epoch and owner registration, event uniqueness and content digest
Verify build instance registration, exact I02-sealed release, R8 universe/manifest, source-free-only derivation and unchanged actual query/predicate/consumer/witness
Require exact site use-registration event for expected site and correct derived token; check handoff same build for N10E C1->N10E route
Check active lifecycle status/validity from owned journal; no cached positive or ordinary caller assertion
Verify conditioner actual effective time and witness effective time are BOTH canonical null; compare snapshot static interval separately to AT07_FIXTURE_ONLY; reject null-vs-nonnull
Verify real_source_effect=false from owner sealed origin, NOT caller Boolean; refuse synthetic rows constructed outside registered owner
Return an owner-internal verified-context projection scoped to invocation and site; receipt and request bind proof refs, not a forged user-provided registry

lifecycle.expiry: No default expiry duration invented. A registered explicit expiry boundary, if adopted, must be identity-bearing and verified using trusted operational validity metadata; otherwise null means no scheduled expiry, NOT forever-current against revocation
lifecycle.revoke: Explicit authorized event invalidates future current-use checks for affected build/context/issuer epoch; cascading dependent contexts fail closed
lifecycle.issuer_revocation: Revoking issuer epoch blocks new registrations and current positive uses unless a separately adopted historical-grace rule exists; none proposed. Archived root remains usable for evidence-only historical audit
lifecycle.reissuance: Fresh event, fresh identity and explicitly authorized lineage; historical credential refs remain immutable and NOT current. Never silent reuse of same object_id or automatic migration
lifecycle.replay: Current-positive N10E replay resolves pinned same original issuer/build/site credential and current status; revoked/expired returns owned authority exception. Separate audit-only historical reproduction MAY verify archived proof as historical explanation but never produce CURRENT results or new use grants; no default latest issuer
lifecycle.no_retroactive_output_relabel: Past immutable receipts preserved exactly; changing eligibility does not rewrite historical semantic result state, only current-use permission

threat_model.attacker: Ordinary untrusted caller, request arguments, raw mappings, fixture rows, copied or syntactically valid ExactRef/receipt, and caller-controlled test helper outputs
threat_model.trusted: HQ-adopted exact warrant bootstrap, owner-controlled registrar journal, verifier independently provisioned from governance-approved trusted deployment root; no authority from user-provided payload
threat_model.not_defended: Arbitrary hostile Python code execution with write access to registrar/verifier process memory, monkeypatching privileged modules, malicious deployment maintainer or compromised HQ governance. Python-private state alone is not a cryptographic security boundary against hostile code.
threat_model.fork_if_required: If code-compromise/F7-style adversary is in scope, separate service/signed attestation and independently verified key custody need distinct HQ warrant; this bounded proposal does not claim it
threat_model.guarantee: Owner/data authority provenance against caller self-attestation, not general adversarial process-security
